# Edge Point

> Strategy-first marketing agency in Malaysia helping SMEs grow with brand foundation, SEO, performance marketing, and events activation.

Edge Point Solutions Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian marketing agency focused on building strategy-led growth systems for SMEs. We work with businesses doing RM500K–RM10M in revenue, combining brand foundation, organic visibility, paid performance, and events activation into one coherent system tied to revenue.

- [Home](/): Overview of Edge Point's strategy-first approach to marketing for Malaysian SMEs.
- [About](/about): Who we are, how we think, and why strategy comes before tactics.
- [Services](/services): Our four service pillars — brand, organic growth, performance, and events.
- [Brand & Foundation](/services/brand-foundation): Positioning, messaging, offers, and website development.
- [Visibility & Organic Growth](/services/visibility-organic-growth): SEO, content, social media, and organic funnels.
- [Performance & Scale](/services/performance-scale): Paid media, performance marketing, funnel optimization, and tracking.
- [Events & Activation](/services/events-activation): Event planning, brand activations, and KOL marketing.
- [Insights](/insights): Articles on marketing strategy, SEO, and growth for SMEs.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch to start a strategic audit or engagement.
